sv.title: Klart: Malmöfestivalen fortsätter till 2030
sv.summary: Malmöfestivalen fortsätter i minst fyra år till. Men den som hoppas på dyra världsartister lär bli besviken – budgeten stiger inte nämnvärt. – De stora artisternas gage springer iväg ganska rejält.

en.title: Confirmed: Malmö Festival continues until 2030
en.summary: The Malmö Festival continues for at least four more years. But anyone hoping for expensive world-famous artists is likely to be disappointed – the budget is not rising significantly. – The fees for major artists are rising quite sharply.
